reconciliation_note: The previous import had no pinned source record. This commit matched its normalized upstream files except the preserved host changes; it was used as the three-way merge base, not asserted as the original import revision.
normalization: Map each upstream crate to native_* internal modules, lib.rs to mod.rs, crate/external paths to internal modules, wgpu to bgi_wgpu, and MPEG to the workspace codec; format Rust with edition 2024 and skip_children=true.
local_changes: CrySirror-owned session worker, immutable completed frames and session-owned 48 kHz stereo PCM; bridge upstream scene/movie scheduling to the existing host output queue.
Keep host-selected bootstrap, optional owner font, input/dialog/window commands and installed-resource view. Detection delegates BP image bounds and archive language tags to the retained runtime.

Primary-root native writes use the private user overlay. Preserve Windows/Unix capability I/O, network user overrides and media sentinels; omit upstream tests that require its narrower writable-name whitelist.
Keep the native GXM session, existing GPU namespace and workspace MPEG codec boundary; standalone upstream launchers/audio devices remain disabled.

Keep the upstream mobile output/recovery module inactive in crysirror-host sessions; the CrySirror host owns device lifecycle and retained PCM output. Compile the frame/PCM adapter only with crysirror-host, while preserving standalone HostRuntime for native renderer consumers.

network_integration.changes: Included in the complete-runtime source pin. Preserve CrySirror client-scoped network readers, Windows capability support, local user overlays and existing defaults.
